IsSuspendSong.when: !PlayerActionManagerBase.get_IsBattleActive(actorAction) AND !UnityEngine.Object.op_Equality(actorAction) AND !UnityEngine.Object.op_Equality(takeController) AND InputManager.get_LeftInputKey(Singleton<InputManager>.get_Instance()) AND IsEnd eq 0 AND IsSelfAction ne 0 AND SkillActionBase.op_Equality(SkillActionManagerBase.get_CurrentSkill(), 0) AND SongBufferBase.CheckTake(this) AND TakeController.get_MainPlayer(takeController).isTakePlay ne 0 AND isChangeSongMotion eq 0

!SongBufferBase.CheckTake(this) AND !UnityEngine.Object.op_Equality(actorAction) AND !UnityEngine.Object.op_Equality(takeController) AND IsEnd eq 0 AND IsSelfAction ne 0 AND PlayerActionManagerBase.get_IsBattleActive(actorAction) AND TakeController.get_MainPlayer(takeController).isTakePlay ne 0 OR !PlayerActionManagerBase.get_IsBattleActive(actorAction) AND !SongBufferBase.CheckTake(this) AND !UnityEngine.Object.op_Equality(actorAction) AND !UnityEngine.Object.op_Equality(takeController) AND IsEnd eq 0 AND IsSelfAction ne 0 AND TakeController.get_MainPlayer(takeController).isTakePlay ne 0 AND isChangeSongMotion ne 0 OR !SongBufferBase.CheckTake(this) AND !UnityEngine.Object.op_Equality(actorAction) AND !UnityEngine.Object.op_Equality(takeController) AND IsEnd eq 0 AND IsSelfAction ne 0 AND PlayerActionManagerBase.get_AbnormalStatusManager().IsActionLock ne 0 AND PlayerActionManagerBase.get_IsBattleActive(actorAction) AND TakeController.get_MainPlayer(takeController).isTakePlay eq 0

suspendedTimer.when: !PlayerActionManagerBase.get_IsBattleActive(actorAction) AND !UnityEngine.Object.op_Equality(actorAction) AND !UnityEngine.Object.op_Equality(takeController) AND InputManager.get_LeftInputKey(Singleton<InputManager>.get_Instance()) AND IsEnd eq 0 AND IsSelfAction ne 0 AND SkillActionBase.op_Equality(SkillActionManagerBase.get_CurrentSkill(), 0) AND SongBufferBase.CheckTake(this) AND TakeController.get_MainPlayer(takeController).isTakePlay ne 0 AND isChangeSongMotion eq 0
